messages:
emma_support: Customer 'NordicRetail AS' submitted a resale certificate and requested VAT-exempt reverse charge for invoice 2026-0457. VIES validation failed when we called /billing/vat/validate -> 'INVALID_FORMAT'. I attached their PDF (nordicretail_resalecert_2026_02.pdf) and a screenshot they sent from Skatteverket. Can billing/finance escalate?

invoice_bot: System: Invoice creation failed for account nordic-retail — error: vat_validation_failed (422). Retry link: https://console.redwood.ai/billing/invoices/2026-0457

josh_billing: @emma_support can you paste the exact VAT ID they submitted and confirm if they also uploaded a signed PO?

emma_support: VAT ID submitted: "SE 556677889901" (note the space). They uploaded a PO (PO-8899) that explicitly references "reverse charge". Attached files in the support ticket.

ivo_finance: @josh_billing @paula_compliance I can approve a manual reverse-charge marking, but we need one of: (a) official national confirmation showing the VAT ID, or (b) resale cert plus signed PO referencing reverse charge. Please attach both if possible.

paula_compliance: VIES sometimes rejects IDs with unexpected whitespace/formatting or certain national edge-cases. If Skatteverket (Swedish authority) shows the ID active we can accept that as evidence; compliance needs to store the source. @emma_support ask the customer for the direct Skatteverket URL or a dated screenshot with the VAT ID visible.

liam_engineer: Quick tech note: our /billing/vat/validate proxy strips non-digit chars but an earlier sanitizer path could leave a leading space which causes VIES to reject with INVALID_FORMAT. If you give me the raw input I can re-run. Also here's the validation payload we used:

```
POST /internal/billing/vat/validate
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "vat_id": "SE 556677889901",
  "source": "support-form",
  "invoice_id": "2026-0457"
}
```

liam_engineer: Re-ran with trimmed VAT "SE556677889901" -> VIES returned valid. So this is a client-side formatting issue. I'll patch the normalization step and kick a manual retry for the invoice.

josh_billing: While the hotfix lands, can finance do the manual override so the customer isn't blocked? @ivo_finance please confirm required artifacts.

ivo_finance: I will approve manual reverse-charge for invoice 2026-0457 once we have: (1) Skatteverket screenshot or official confirmation, (2) resale certificate PDF, (3) PO-8899. Add these to the invoice notes and tag compliance.

paula_compliance: Logged. Once documents are in the ticket I'll add them to the compliance evidence store and sign off. We should also add a frontend validation hint to strip spaces/case on VAT ID input to reduce repeats. :+1:

emma_support: Uploaded Skatteverket screenshot, the resale cert PDF, and PO-8899 to the ticket. Customer said they can wait 24h for final invoice. Thanks everyone.

invoice_bot: System: Invoice 2026-0457 updated: status=approved_manual_override, tags=[reverse_charge, vat-exempt]. :white_check_mark:
